title: Understanding Variance
text: Variance in a model refers to how much the model's predictions change when using different subsets of the training data. Consider how removing a feature like 'veg' might affect this variability.

title: Role of the 'veg' Feature
text: The 'veg' feature captures the amount of vegetables bought. Think about how this feature contributes to the model's ability to fit the data and how its removal might impact the model's flexibility.
